extras.real_size: two spool turbofan teaching cutaway, fan 1.62 m, about 3.65 m long, on an engine stand
extras.notes: Generic high bypass turbofan without logos as a teaching cutaway: nacelle and core casing have the upper front quarter cut away (cut faces red). Visible: spinner and 20 wide chord fan blades, bypass outlet guide vanes, 3 stage booster, 5 stage high pressure compressor with stator rows, annular combustor (copper) with fuel nozzles, 1 stage high pressure and 3 stage low pressure turbine (brass) with nozzle guide vanes, core nozzle and exhaust cone. Rests in two painted saddles on a stand frame. Rotating part: 'rotor' (spinner, fan, compressor and turbine rotors on the shaft, axis X), origin on the axis.

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
